mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE rose by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS declined over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) within the last month signals a strengthening economy, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased and UNRATE decreased in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the last three months signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals easing inflationary pressures, which leads to increased consumer purchasing power and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) within the last quarter signals a robust economic expansion, which leads to increased consumer and business confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased in the last quarter.
